master_script.hook: Cafe owners, aapke 4 mein se 3 customers reply miss kar rahe hain…

hooks.text: Cafe owners, aapke 4 mein se 3 customers reply miss kar rahe hain…
30 second mein aapka WhatsApp lead kaise pakda ja sakta hai…
Shayad aap agree na karo, par chatbot raat ka staff ban sakta hai…
Der se reply hi wajah hai ki aapke customers kahin aur chale jaate hain…
Ye aapko hairan kar sakta hai: WhatsApp pe lead bina number ke chali jati hai…
Raat 11 baje ek customer WhatsApp karta hai, aap busy hote hain, aur uska message ankahee reh jata hai, customer chala jata hai.

beats.line: Cafe owners, aapke 4 mein se 3 customers reply miss kar rahe hain…
beats.visual: Phone screen showing unread WhatsApp chat at 11pm

beats.line: WhatsApp chats database nahi hote, isliye naam aur number copy na karne se lead hamesha gum ho jati hai.

beats.line: Par aapka chatbot sirf reply hi nahi karta, woh kya karta hai?
WhatsApp ko AI chatbot se jodte hain, 24x7 reply milta hai; quick replies se naam, number aur do ya teen sawal poochte hain, aur do qualifiers se problem aur decision‑maker ko qualify karte hain.
beats.visual: WhatsApp chat window with quick reply buttons
steps: WhatsApp ko AI chatbot se jodna
Replies se naam, number, sawal poochna

beats.line: Maine 5 local businesses ko WhatsApp par message kiya; 4 ne reply nahi diya, lekin ek ka AI assistant ek minute mein reply de gaya.
beats.visual: WhatsApp chat list showing 5 contacts, one reply bubble

master_script.linkedin_english: Many cafe owners lose inquiries because WhatsApp chats aren’t stored. An AI chatbot can reply instantly, collect name and number, and qualify leads with two key questions. Comment BOT to receive a checklist that shows how this works for your business.

marketing.gets: a one-page checklist: the 10 questions a WhatsApp reply bot should answer for your business, so you can see if it fits

facts.claim: 55% of WhatsApp leads arrived without a mobile number, making it hard to follow up.
facts.title: Implementation of the Month: How a University in Lima Captures WhatsApp Leads That Arrive Without a Phone Number Using AI and Zoho –...

facts.claim: WhatsApp chats are not a database, so businesses should copy essential details like name and number into a shared sheet or CRM.
facts.title: How can businesses organise WhatsApp enquiries? Darsh Innovations

facts.claim: Using quick replies that ask the two or three essential questions you always need answered helps capture name and contact number early in the conversation.
facts.title: How can businesses organise WhatsApp enquiries? Darsh Innovations

facts.claim: A simple WhatsApp CRM for small businesses should track name and WhatsApp number as core fields.
facts.title: WhatsApp CRM for Indian small businesses: a simple setup — KutrimBots

facts.claim: Qualify leads in the first three messages by asking two qualifiers – what the prospect is trying to solve and who will decide – to filter and capture details quickly.
facts.title: WhatsApp lead capture: turning conversations into qualified pipeline LeadManagement

facts.claim: WhatsApp chat lists are sorted by the latest message, not by buyer readiness, causing hot leads to sink below newer chats and leading to missed follow‑ups and missing information.
facts.title: WhatsApp CRM for Indian small businesses: a simple setup — KutrimBots

facts.claim: Pre‑filling the initial WhatsApp message with context (e.g., "Hi, I'd like a quote for {product}") tells the sales team the prospect’s intent before the chat starts.
facts.title: WhatsApp lead capture: turning conversations into qualified pipeline LeadManagement

facts.claim: Switching from personal WhatsApp to the free WhatsApp Business app provides a business profile, labels, quick replies, and greeting messages that help structure enquiries and capture contact details.
facts.title: How can businesses organise WhatsApp enquiries? Darsh Innovations

master_script.topic: Why do most of your WhatsApp enquiries end without a name or contact number?
